title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT's own office suite | TechCrunch
summary: At its DevDay developer conference in San Francisco on Tuesday, OpenAI announced several new ChatGPT features designed for office workers. As OpenAI edges into Microsoft’s territory, Microsoft and other software companies like Salesforce are busy trying to become more like OpenAI.
